comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a flat five-file ESM implementation with parser, program-name, schedule error, schedule-like shim, and entrypoint modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a nested seven-file ESM implementation with CLI, runtime, schedule error, schedule index, job, and entrypoint modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The module organization differed, but both implemented the same parser and schedule surface required by the prompt.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used fewer resources, no subagents, and also finished without timeout and with a passing official result.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel incurred extra coordination and duplicate probing cost, but it did not displace required work or shorten closure enough to cause failure.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official records show no discordant outcome: both parallel and serial passed all 70 official samples. The task-solving difference is that the parallel run delegated executable probing to one child and also probed locally before writing a flatter module tree, while the serial run did all probing and implementation in one actor with a nested module tree. Both delivered ESM .mjs code, local imports only, manual argument parsing, schedule-like validation, matching Job output, local verification, and a passing official artifact.
parallel_contributors: The child probe returned before implementation and gave the parent usable behavioral evidence.
The parent retained implementation and final delivery ownership, then verified representative CLI and invalid-time cases.
serial_contributors: The single serial actor probed the executable directly and retained all findings locally.
The serial actor built and verified the complete entrypoint and library tree without handoff boundaries.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used a flat lib layout with five generated files, while serial used a nested CLI/runtime/schedule layout with seven generated files.
Parallel spent more time and tokens because of child delegation and duplicate probing, but this was not an adverse retained coordination pattern.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; both solutions passed, so retained failure labels require an independent realized parallel adverse process consequence
